description: Don't wrap a dependency, or a cheap operator or property-read expression over only the dependencies, in useMemo; use or compute it during render.

violation.message: Use `$E` directly instead of this useMemo: it only hands back a value already in its dependency list, so other dependencies never give it a new identity.
Read `$E` inline during render instead of in useMemo, unless it is a getter that builds a new object or you mean to keep the first value while the object mutates in place.
Compute `$E` inline during render instead of in useMemo: it reads only the memo's dependencies and costs less than the dependency check.
